_note: Surnames that read as a real company once a firm wears them (docs/fictionalization.md: no real company's name). A PERSON may keep one; a FIRM may not. tools/firms_generate.py swaps any of these out of a firm name after the draw (retire_brand_surnames, draw-free) and its --check fails on a firm name that still carries one; tests/test_companies_tiers.gd fails on the same, so CI stops the next one. They stay in the surname pools on purpose: the pools are drawn by rng.choice, and removing a name shifts every later draw, regenerating whole nations (firms and bench people). Add a brand here, re-run the generator, commit both.
